ocl.definition: lt:LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o | o.ItemID = itemid and o.Content = content)
ocl.postcondition: if lt.oclIsUndefined() then let newLT:LoanTerm in newLT.oclIsNew() and LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newLT) and newLT.ItemID = itemid and newLT.Content = content and result = true else result = false endif
